description:
Create, update, or delete a saved contact. Set `action` to choose the operation.

- create: requires phone_number and name
- update: requires contact_id; only the fields you pass are changed
- delete: requires contact_id (permanent)

contact_id refers to a saved contact. Create and update return the saved contact (id, name, phone number, email, notes); delete returns a success flag.

action.description: Which operation to run: create a new contact, update an existing one, or delete one (delete is permanent).

contact_id.description: ID of the contact to act on, from list_contacts. Required for 'update' and 'delete'.

email.description: An email address to save with the contact.

notes.description: Freeform notes to store with the contact, for your reference.

phone_number.description: The contact's phone number in full international form with country code (e.g. +14155551234). Required for 'create'.

name: manage_contact

outputSchema.description: The saved contact (create/update), or a success flag (delete).

id.description: The contact's unique ID (use as contact_id).

notes.description: Free-text notes about the contact, or null.

success.description: Present on delete: whether it succeeded.

updatedAt.description: When the contact was last updated (ISO 8601).

title: Manage Contact
